findings.summary: The interrupted-claim completion guard in DdControlPlane.gate is unreachable in production: _generation_launched matches any launch entry for the generation, and a development that is awaiting_gate at generation N necessarily already has the fresh generation-N entry that got it to the gate. So whenever the O_EXCL claim already exists, the third conjunct is true and the gate returns already_resumed without launching — including in the crash-in-the-claim/act-window case it was added to fix. DdOwnerSource maps that to RESUME_ALREADY_RESUMED and the bridge seals STATUS_RESUMED for a recovery that never ran, leaving the development awaiting_gate (recovered only by the 60s GateAutoResumer). This is the unresolved attempt-2 finding on the DD path; test_an_interrupted_claim_without_launch_is_completed passes only because its _suspended fixture builds an awaiting_gate development with no launches.jsonl, a shape production never reaches. The line half (owners.py:301-328, test_resume_completes_an_interrupted_claim) is genuinely fixed.

The shipped unit passes --lines-config /data/fleet-graph/config/ronin-lines.json, a path nothing in the repo installs or references; the roster's declared home is the in-repo config/ronin-lines.json (docs/operating.md:136), which fleet-graphd.service reads as /data/apps/fleet-graph/current/config/ronin-lines.json. cli.py:561 opens it with no guard, so a missing or malformed roster raises out of _decision_bridge_run and Restart=on-failure/RestartSec=5 turns startup into a permanent crash loop — the bridge never polls the board and line recovery (spec items 4-5) never runs. This contradicts the unit's own header rationale and the bridge's fail-soft posture on every other input (missing env file, missing bus token → recorded degradation, not a crash). test_exec_start_parses_as_the_cli_subcommand checks only argparse acceptance, not roster readability.

The committed Continuous review for this attempt records both attempt-2 findings as fully resolved. That holds for the line half but not for the DD half (finding 1). The Continuous APPROVE stands as its own record on its own subject; this Final judgment is reached independently and does not restate or amend it.

Disclosure, not a defect claim: the mechanical product-equality check between 531f5bda and 9590e308 (git diff --exit-code excluding .dev-dispatch) was NOT executed — this reviewer has only read-only file inspection and shell access confined to the run workdir, which cannot reach the worktree. No claim is made in either direction about whether the review materialization was metadata-only; the review covers the worktree tree contents as read at /data/worktrees/fleet-graph-e1-extension-fresh-20260828. The REJECT rests on the two spec-conformance findings above, independently of that unperformed check.
